summary: Short corner kerb at a junction, too steep, with no stopping signs.
reasons: At a junction mouth, 14 m long

drivers.seclusion: School 19 m away, a house beyond; building site beside the corner.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb right at the Fairley/Ward junction; less than a van length once the corner is clear.
drivers.traffic: Junction of two through streets, busy with turning traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park further down the street, not at this corner.

flags: No Stopping Any Time signs at the corner
sun_shade: Open to sun; tree cover to the west.
rubbish: Building materials in the adjoining plot, not dumping.
